duration: Teen volunteers: one 1 hour shift a week in summer. Book Buddies: one weekly time slot for all of July (Tuesdays 3 to 5 p.m. or Wednesdays 5 to 7 p.m.).
pay_detail: Unpaid. The page mentions it can help with school community service hours.
name: Tween and Teen Volunteers and Book Buddies (summer)
what_you_do: Help around the library with craft prep and light cleaning. Or be a Book Buddy. You are paired with a young reader entering grades 1 to 3.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 5 to 12 who live in River Forest. You must attend an orientation, and a parent or guardian must sign the release and waiver.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 deadline was Friday, May 1 and the page says Summer 2026 applications are now closed. 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen/Tween Volunteer form or the Book Buddies form online. Or print it. Email the form to volunteer@riverforestlibrary.org or drop it off at the library.
notes: River Forest residents only. The page says both that Summer 2026 applications are closed and that they are open, so it is out of date. Ask the library when the next call opens.
